categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Adds a new fuzz harness in src/test/fuzz/musig.cpp and registers it in src/test/fuzz/CMakeLists.txt under the Fuzzing label.
categories.rationale: Adds fuzz testing coverage for previously untested MuSig module signing and aggregation functions. As noted in review, 'the four signing functions in the module have no unit test today... so the harness covers ground that was empty', exercising edge cases and malformed inputs against new cryptographic wrapper APIs.
